title: Heat map
estimateNote: Heat Score: NASA/USGS Landsat surface temperature (sharpened with ECOSTRESS where available), MODIS night heat and ESA WorldCover land cover, per 15,000 m² hex. Grey hexes have no data yet.
gibsNote: Zoomed out: NASA MODIS daily surface temperature (~1 km). Zoomed in: Landsat hexes.
tieNote: Scores within ±3 are flagged as near-ties — treat them as equally hot.

empty.title: No hot zones found here
empty.sub: Try a wider radius or another place.
